text:
Sam Nunez: hey folks  day-zero here on runtime team. laptop's good but I'm hitting 403 on `kubectl get pods` and can't see the infra project in GCP console. who do I ping for cloud perms? also where's team standup and what's lunch like? :wave:

Linh Tran: welcome Sam! pinging @IT Support for perms. Standup is 10:30 in #eng-standup and we usually order lunch Tue/Thu. :pizza:

Omar Lee: hi Sam 44b I'm your onboarding buddy. quick 1:1 at 3pm? I'll add you to the runtime runbook channel and expose the PR templates.

IT Support: Hi @Sam Nunez 4bb Please run `gcloud auth list` and paste the active account (only the account email). Also run `kubectl config view --minify --flatten` and redact tokens before pasting. We'll check IAM bindings.

Sam Nunez: active account is sam.nunez@redwood.com. Pasting snippets now.

IT Support: thanks. You were missing the "redwood-infra-dev" IAM role on the project. I've added you to the group 'redwood-runtime-devs'. Try `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-infra --filter="bindings.members:sam.nunez@redwood.com"` to verify.

Onboard Bot: Onboarding checklist updated for Sam Nunez: sso_provisioned: true, gcp_access: true, ssh_key_added: false, slack_invite: true.

Maya Ortiz: Sam, for SSH key use `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sam.nunez@redwood.com"` then `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` on mac and paste into https://git.redwood.com/settings/keys. I just invited you to the onboarding-repo.

Sam Nunez: added SSH key and can clone now. thanks! Also FYI I build tiny sailboat models as a hobby and race them at the lake on weekends 3a46a4.

Linh Tran: love the hobby 44f. Friday show-and-tell is perfect for that.

HR Bot: Welcome Sam! Orientation starts 9am tomorrow in #all-hands. Please complete the payroll form: https://redwood.inference/hr/payroll. :tada:

Omar Lee: 3pm buddy check-in still on. We'll go through runbooks and your first-week tasks (alert oncall walk-through, small infra PR).

IT Support: Verified ssh_key_added: true. GCP role propagation may take a few minutes; try `gcloud auth login --relogin` if you hit stale token errors.

Sam Nunez: everything green now 44d. Thanks everyone for the fast help and warm welcome!
